title: Initialize Communities
description: Assign each node to its own singleton community. Initialize modularity Q and compute node degrees and total edge weight (2m).

title: Local Moving (Phase 1)
description: Similar to Louvain: iterate over nodes in random order. For each node, compute ΔQ of moving to neighboring communities. Move to community yielding maximum positive gain. Repeat until no improvement possible.

title: Refinement (Phase 2)
description: Split each community from Phase 1 into sub-communities to ensure well-connectedness. For each community, initialize each node as its own refined sub-community. Merge nodes locally within the community while ensuring all sub-communities remain connected. This guarantees no internally disconnected communities.

title: Graph Aggregation (Phase 3)
description: Build a compressed graph where refined sub-communities become super-nodes. Edge weights between super-nodes are sums of edge weights between their constituent nodes. The refined partition (not the Phase 1 partition) determines the aggregation.

title: Recursive Application
description: Apply Phases 1-3 recursively on the aggregated graph. Continue until modularity cannot be improved further, creating a hierarchy of increasingly coarse communities.
